laura (Customer): Hey team — our Feb invoice (INV-2026-0045) shows 2,400 reserved GPU hours billed for our dedicated pool but the console shows ~1,608.5 consumed. Also token burn looks way lower than expected. Can someone help reconcile? pool=rp-9a3f

sophie (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, laura. Can you confirm the exact billing window and whether any burst capacity was enabled?

laura (Customer): window: 2026-02-01..2026-02-28. We did have burst enabled for short spikes. Quick snapshot from our dashboard: 
```
pool: rp-9a3f
dashboard_reserved_hours_consumed: 1608.5
dashboard_burst_hours: 0 (console shows 0, but invoice lists 800 burst hours)
invoice_reserved_hours_charged: 2400
invoice_burst_hours_charged: 800
invoice_id: INV-2026-0045
```

sophie (Support): Thanks. tagging @raj for billing help and @derek for metering parity.

raj (Billing): Looking. Can you paste the customer org ID and the exact invoice line items? I can hold the charge for review if this is an overbilling.

laura (Customer): org_id: org_7f3b. I attached the invoice PDF in case it helps (sent privately).

ops-bot: metering-query job queued -> job_id=mq-8842. ETA ~ 2m

ops-bot: metering-query result: dedicated_metering_sum(gpu_hours)=2399.8 for pool rp-9a3f in 2026-02-01..2026-02-28

sophie (Support): That's odd — dashboard shows 1608.5 but raw metering events sum ~2399.8. @derek any idea why the dashboard and metering aggregate diverge?

derek (Eng): Two quick possibilities: 1) dashboard rollup uses sampled/approved events and may exclude fallback-hosted traffic; 2) we had a known edge-case where metering events were duplicated when fallback routing triggered during deployment rollouts (counts were emitted for both dedicated -> fallback endpoints). I'm going to check routing logs for x-redwood-route-version headers and metering emission points.

derek (Eng): repro query I'm running now: 
```
-- raw events
SELECT event_id, ts, route, fallback, gpu_hours
FROM metering.events
WHERE pool_id='rp-9a3f' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ops-bot: query returned 12k events; sampling 5 rows:
```
{"event_id":"m-112233","ts":"2026-02-14T03:12:22Z","route":"dedicated","fallback":false,"gpu_hours":0.05}
{"event_id":"m-112234","ts":"2026-02-14T03:12:22Z","route":"fallback-hosted","fallback":true,"gpu_hours":0.05}
{"event_id":"m-112235","ts":"2026-02-14T03:12:23Z","route":"dedicated","fallback":false,"gpu_hours":0.10}
```

sophie (Support): If events exist for both dedicated and fallback at the same timestamp that would explain doubled billing for the same work. @raj can you pause invoicing for this line while we investigate?

raj (Billing): Pausing adjustment queue for INV-2026-0045, line reserved_capacity. I'll flag as "under review" and not apply auto-charge.

derek (Eng): Found pivot: deploy job deploy-2026-02-14T03 triggered a canary rollout where routing policy temporarily emitted both dedicated and fallback traces for a small percentage. Metering emitter didn't dedupe by request_id. Fix: dedupe on request_id at emission time + backfill to collapse duplicates.

derek (Eng): Quick repro steps for eng-oncall: 
1) start a canary that routes 5% to fallback
2) send steady traffic that triggers GPU allocation
3) observe metering.events containing both route entries with identical request_id
4) confirm gpu_hours doubled in raw sums

laura (Customer): Thanks — please let me know the ETA for resolution and whether we'll get a credit for the 800 burst/reserved delta. This is critical for our finance review.

derek (Eng): I'll open a patch and a backfill job. Estimated timeline: patch in 6 hours, backfill job to run overnight (~8–12h), then we can produce corrected metering and provide line-item credit calc.

raj (Billing): Noted. I'll provisionally estimate credit = invoice_reserved_hours_charged - corrected_metering_reserved_hours. I'll wait for backfill output before finalizing.

sophie (Support): Action items: 1) @derek push fix + backfill, include audit diff CSV; 2) @raj hold/adjust invoice and prepare provisional credit notice; 3) @laura we will follow up in this thread with the corrected hours and expected credit amount. Sorry for the disruption :disappointed:

laura (Customer): Appreciate the quick triage. Please CC our finance contact (fin_amelia@customerco.com) when you send the credit details.

ops-bot: ticket created -> TICKET-5809 (metering-duplication-rp-9a3f). Assigned to eng-runtime.

sophie (Support): Thanks everyone — moving to eng-runtime for fix. I'll update laura and cc finance when we have the corrected numbers.
